name: Tokenizer
description: Japanese morphological analysis via the JPDB parse API. Requires your own JPDB API key. Tokenizes text into morphemes with readings, furigana, and pitch accent for furigana display and word-boundary detection.

apiKey.label: JPDB API key
apiKey.description: Get your API key from jpdb.io/settings (Account tab). Used for parsing Japanese text into morphemes.
